name: Ogun language server
summary: Language Server Protocol server for *.workflow.json in any LSP client: diagnostics from the runtime's validator, hover, completion, definition, symbols and a workflow hash lens.

egress.note: None. A stdio process that never connects to ogund.

implementation.evidence: Unit tests and a full LSP session over an in-memory connection; also used by the VS Code client tests. Not tried in Neovim, Helix, JetBrains or Zed.

notes: Run it as ogun lsp or ogun-lsp: stdio transport, file pattern *.workflow.json, language JSON. Diagnostics come only from ogun_ir::check and never quote configuration values. Read-only: it never runs a workflow and is not an approval surface (O-14 section 2.1). It uses the built-in operator catalogue.
